Sometimes, a few million years of natural selection gets it right the first time. Indeed, while the industry largely relies on polyester for fleece items, we’re proud of the natural, completely recycled wool fleece we use in our Woolaroo products that's breathable, odor-resistant, and quick-drying.
We had to have this in a vest, so we took the Woolaroo’s renowned natural softness and warmth, chopped the arms off, and gave it some added freedom of movement for the handsome, new Woolaroo Vest. But what else would you expect from us?
